caption:
Not asking for directions

Cella walked past the same person three times and still did not ask.

People asked for directions almost always help, and far more often than the asker expects.

For the friend who would rather circle the block.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

#naos #chooseFriction

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks back and forth across the room past a royal blue one that stands still on the right, watching. A clock above them counts the minutes up. The black one narrows its eyes each pass. At the end its eyes go wide and it trembles. The text changes from: me not asking for directions, to: asked: 10 seconds. found it: 2 minutes.
